title: The edge is gone by about 30 bps
subtitle: Out of sample Sharpe of the weekly rebalanced ridge against one way cost per unit traded
xLabel: one way cost per unit traded, bps (fee plus slippage)
caption: Turnover is the same 15.9% a day in every run, so Sharpe falls almost linearly and crosses zero near 30 bps. Adding square root impact at a $50M book on top of the baseline costs gives a Sharpe of -1.078, and rebalancing daily at 15 bps gives 0.122.
source: projects/leakage-checked-backtester/results/experiments.csv, rows no_costs, fee_5, baseline, fee_20, fee_40
